Diagnostic.description: One structured finding with a stable code, the JSON Pointer of the input it concerns, a message and a repair hint.

code.description: Stable code such as `CRN-E012` or `CRN-W001`, part of the machine contract.

message.description: Human-readable detail; its wording is not part of the contract.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Empty string denotes the document root.

Replicate.description: Accounting of one replicate; every requested id has exactly one record.

diagnostic.description: The error that ended the replicate, such as a failed check or a rejected population-limit update; absent when it completed.

events.description: Events executed; an event that was rejected (population limit) is not counted.

id.description: Replicate id, which also selects its random stream.

saved_points.description: Save times for which a state was recorded, a prefix of the save grid.

started.description: False for a replicate that a stop prevented from starting; it then has no events and no saved points.

stop_time.description: The latest certified time of the path in seconds: the horizon for a completed replicate, otherwise the last event or save time reached.

ResultVersion.description: Schema tag of a tau-leaping result.

Severity.description: Whether a diagnostic blocks use of the input or result: `error` does, `warning` is advisory.

Statistics.description: Ensemble statistics: one row per save time, one value per species. Present only for a fully completed ensemble.

mean_standard_error.description: Standard error of the mean, sqrt(variance / n), when `mean` was requested and n > 1.

sample_variance.description: Unbiased sample variance (denominator n − 1) when `variance` was requested.

samples.description: Number of replicates summarized, equal to the requested replicates.

Stop.description:
How a replicate, or the whole run, ended.

The declaration order is the aggregation priority: a run reports the largest replicate value, except that `output_limit` is set when retained output was removed.

Trajectory.description: Saved states of one retained replicate.

counts.description: One row of counts in species order per recorded save time; only the replicate's `saved_points` rows if it stopped early.

id.description: Replicate id; trajectories are kept for ids 0 to `keep_trajectories` − 1.

description: Approximate Poisson-leaping result. It is never an exact ensemble.

events.description: Reaction firings over all replicates, leaps and exact steps together.

leaps.description: Accepted leaps and exact fallback steps over all replicates.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model bytes.

rejected_leaps.description: Leap proposals rejected because they would make a count negative or consume more molecules than present.

replicates.description: One record per requested replicate, in id order.

request_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact tau request bytes.

save_times.description: The reference run's save grid in seconds.

species.description: Species names in the order used by every count row.

statistics.description: Requested statistics, present only when every replicate completed.

trajectories.description: Saved states of the first `keep_trajectories` replicates.

title: TauResult
